_doc: Biome = a soft look preset any scene can apply to ANY set (scene field `biome`, inherited until changed, "none" resets). It only fills `treat` / `medium` / `weather` when the scene does not set them itself, so the story always wins. Examples: {"loc":"jungle","biome":"frozen"} = a frost-covered jungle; {"loc":"town_square","biome":"flooded"} = the plaza underwater.
